# Virtualization metric refinements

Metric refinements extend upstream OpenTelemetry metrics with additional
entity associations and attributes specific to the
Virtualization domain.

| Upstream Metric | Refinement ID | Entity Associations | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `container.cpu.time` | `refinement.virtualization.container.cpu.time` | virtualization.vm | CPU time consumed by the virtual machine. |
| `container.cpu.usage` | `refinement.virtualization.container.cpu.usage` | virtualization.vm | CPU usage of the virtual machine, measured in cpus. |
| `container.disk.io` | `refinement.virtualization.container.disk.io` | virtualization.vm | Disk bytes transferred to or from the virtual machine. |
| `container.filesystem.available` | `refinement.virtualization.container.filesystem.available` | virtualization.vm | Filesystem available bytes for the virtual machine. |
| `container.filesystem.capacity` | `refinement.virtualization.container.filesystem.capacity` | virtualization.vm | Filesystem capacity of the virtual machine. |
| `container.filesystem.usage` | `refinement.virtualization.container.filesystem.usage` | virtualization.vm | Filesystem usage of the virtual machine. |
| `container.memory.available` | `refinement.virtualization.container.memory.available` | virtualization.vm | Memory available to the virtual machine. |
| `container.memory.paging.faults` | `refinement.virtualization.container.memory.paging.faults` | virtualization.vm | Memory paging faults of the virtual machine. |
| `container.memory.rss` | `refinement.virtualization.container.memory.rss` | virtualization.vm | RSS memory of the virtual machine. |
| `container.memory.usage` | `refinement.virtualization.container.memory.usage` | virtualization.vm | Memory usage of the virtual machine. |
| `container.memory.working_set` | `refinement.virtualization.container.memory.working_set` | virtualization.vm | Working set memory of the virtual machine. |
| `container.network.io` | `refinement.virtualization.container.network.io` | virtualization.vm | Network bytes transferred by the virtual machine. |
| `container.uptime` | `refinement.virtualization.container.uptime` | virtualization.vm | Time the virtual machine has been running. |
| `hw.energy` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.energy` | virtualization.platform | Energy consumed by a hardware component of the virtualization platform. |
| `hw.errors` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.errors` | virtualization.platform | Number of errors encountered by a hardware component of the virtualization platform. |
| `hw.host.ambient_temperature` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.host.ambient_temperature` | virtualization.platform | Ambient temperature of the virtualization platform hardware. |
| `hw.host.energy` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.host.energy` | virtualization.platform | Total energy consumed by the virtualization platform hardware, in joules. |
| `hw.host.heating_margin` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.host.heating_margin` | virtualization.platform | Heating margin of the virtualization platform hardware before a warning threshold is reached. |
| `hw.host.power` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.host.power` | virtualization.platform | Instantaneous power consumed by the virtualization platform hardware in Watts. |
| `hw.network.bandwidth.limit` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.network.bandwidth.limit` | virtualization.vswitch | Link speed of a network adapter of the virtual switch. |
| `hw.network.bandwidth.utilization` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.network.bandwidth.utilization` | virtualization.vswitch | Network bandwidth utilization fraction for a network adapter of the virtual switch. |
| `hw.network.io` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.network.io` | virtualization.vswitch | Received and transmitted bytes on a network adapter of the virtual switch. |
| `hw.network.packets` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.network.packets` | virtualization.vswitch | Received and transmitted packets on a network adapter of the virtual switch. |
| `hw.network.up` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.network.up` | virtualization.vswitch | Link status of a network adapter of the virtual switch. |
| `hw.power` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.power` | virtualization.platform | Instantaneous power consumed by a hardware component of the virtualization platform. |
| `hw.status` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.status` | virtualization.platform | Operational status of a hardware component of the virtualization platform. |
| `hw.temperature` | `refinement.virtualization.hw.temperature` | virtualization.platform | Temperature reported by a named sensor of the virtualization platform hardware. |
| `system.cpu.time` | `refinement.virtualization.system.cpu.time` | virtualization.platform, virtualization.partition, virtualization.vm | Seconds each logical CPU spent on each mode, extended for virtualization entities. |
| `system.cpu.utilization` | `refinement.virtualization.system.cpu.utilization` | virtualization.platform, virtualization.partition, virtualization.vm | Per-logical-CPU utilization by mode, extended for virtualization entities. |
| `system.disk.limit` | `refinement.virtualization.system.disk.limit` | virtualization.platform, virtualization.storage_pool | Total storage capacity of the disk, extended for virtualization storage pool entities. |
| `system.network.errors` | `refinement.virtualization.system.network.errors` | virtualization.partition, virtualization.vm, virtualization.vswitch | Network error count, extended for virtualization vswitch entities. |
| `system.network.io` | `refinement.virtualization.system.network.io` | virtualization.partition, virtualization.vm, virtualization.vswitch | Bytes transmitted and received, extended for virtualization vswitch entities. |
| `system.network.packet.count` | `refinement.virtualization.system.network.packet.count` | virtualization.partition, virtualization.vm, virtualization.vswitch | Packet transfer count, extended for virtualization vswitch entities. |

## `refinement.virtualization.container.cpu.time`

Refines upstream metric: `container.cpu.time`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `container.cpu.time` | Counter | `s` | CPU time consumed by the virtual machine. [1] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `virtualization.vm` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[1]:** CPU time consumed by the specific container on all available CPU cores

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `virtualization.vm.id` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | Unique identifier for the virtual machine instance. [1] | `vm-0abc1234`; `8c3f2a1b-4d56-4e78-9f01-2a3b4c5d6e7f` |
| `cpu.mode` | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) | `Conditionally Required` Required if mode is available. | string | The CPU mode for this data point. A container's CPU metric SHOULD be characterized _either_ by data points with no `mode` labels, _or only_ data points with `mode` labels. [2] | `user`; `system` |

**[1] `virtualization.vm.id`:** The unique identifier of the virtual machine this CPU time measurement belongs to.

**[2] `cpu.mode`:** Following modes SHOULD be used for VMs if available: `user`, `system`.

| `system` | System | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |
| `user` | User | ![Release Candidate](https://img.shields.io/badge/-rc-mediumorchid) |

## `refinement.virtualization.container.cpu.usage`

Refines upstream metric: `container.cpu.usage`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `container.cpu.usage` | Gauge | `{cpu}` | CPU usage of the virtual machine, measured in cpus. [2] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `virtualization.vm` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[2]:** CPU usage of the specific container on all available CPU cores. It is calculated as the change in cumulative CPU time (container.cpu.time) over a measurement interval, divided by the elapsed time: usageCores = (cpuTimeEnd - cpuTimeStart) / elapsedSeconds

A container's CPU metric SHOULD be characterized _either_ by data points with no `mode` labels, _or only_ data points with `mode` labels. [4] | `user`; `system` |

**[3] `virtualization.vm.id`:** The unique identifier of the virtual machine this CPU usage measurement belongs to.

**[4] `cpu.mode`:** Following modes SHOULD be used for VMs if available: `user`, `system`.

## `refinement.virtualization.container.memory.available`

Refines upstream metric: `container.memory.available`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `container.memory.available` | UpDownCounter | `By` | Memory available to the virtual machine. [7] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `virtualization.vm` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[7]:** Available memory for use.  This is defined as the memory limit - workingSetBytes. If memory limit is undefined, the available bytes is omitted.
In general, this metric can be derived from [cadvisor](https://github.com/google/cadvisor/blob/v0.53.0/docs/storage/prometheus.md#prometheus-container-metrics) and by subtracting the `container_memory_working_set_bytes` metric from the `container_spec_memory_limit_bytes` metric.
In K8s, this metric is derived from the [MemoryStats.AvailableBytes](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/kubelet@v0.34.0/pkg/apis/stats/v1alpha1#MemoryStats) field of the [ContainerStats.Memory](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/kubelet@v0.34.0/pkg/apis/stats/v1alpha1#ContainerStats) of the Kubelet's stats API.

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `virtualization.vm.id` | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | Unique identifier for the virtual machine instance. [9] | `vm-0abc1234`; `8c3f2a1b-4d56-4e78-9f01-2a3b4c5d6e7f` |

**[9] `virtualization.vm.id`:** The unique identifier of the virtual machine this available memory measurement belongs to.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aap` | Application Assist Processor (zAAP) — a specialty IBM Z processor for Java workloads, deprecated in z13 and later models. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `all` | Aggregate across all processor types allocated to this partition. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cbp` | Coupling Bus Processor (CBP) — a processor type dedicated to HiperSockets network coupling on IBM Z. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cp` | Central Processor (CP) — the general-purpose IBM Z processor type. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `icf` | Internal Coupling Facility (ICF) — a processor type used for sysplex coupling on IBM Z. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `ifl` | Integrated Facility for Linux (IFL) — a processor type optimised for Linux workloads on IBM Z. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `iip` | z Integrated Information Processor (zIIP) — a specialty engine for eligible Java and DB2 workloads on IBM Z. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `unknown` | Processor type is not known or the platform does not differentiate by processor type. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
